rows.note: This is the all-purpose standalone possessive for something belonging to you.

example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 ze1 hai6 nei5 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically when “yours” means your home or place.

example.english: I'm going to yours for dinner tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 nei5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this as a formal written letter closing before or with the signature.

example.english: Write “Yours sincerely” at the end of the letter, then sign it.
example.traditional: 封信最後寫「謹上」再簽名。
example.jyutping: fung1 seon3 zeoi3 hau6 se2 gan2 soeng6 zoi3 cim1 meng2
